notes.title: ✨🥳 Cursed Broom ist out NOW 🥳✨
notes.notes:
Purchase Cursed Broom now for 10% off!

It's been a wild ride but we are finally here. Cursed Broom is officially released! We would like to give a big 'Thank you!' to everyone who supported us on the journey and hope you have as much fun playing the game as we had developing it.

See you in the skies!

Cursed Creations

notes.title: 🎉😱 Cursed Broom releases in 24 hours 😱🎉
notes.notes:
We're almost there! Tomorrow this time around Cursed Broom will be available for purchase! We're so excited to hear about your experiences!

See you tomorrow at 2pm CEST!

Cursed Creations

notes.title: 🧹✨ Cursed Broom Live Stream Tonight ✨🧹
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We've been keeping an eye on how many of you have played our demo and are thrilled to get all your kind messages via mail or TikTok.

As part of Steam Next Fest we asked [url=https://www.twitch.tv/littlesongbjrd]LittleSongBjrd[/url] to play through our demo content with us. Join our Live Stream as we discuss development processes and the build up to our release on the 31st of October!

Thank you so much for your ongoing support and see you tonight! We'll be live at 7pm CEST on our Steam Page.

Cursed Creations
